findings.summary: The search-bar + choice-chip row + result-count row is a full bespoke reimplementation of the shared MobileFilterBar widget, diverging from every other page.
findings.fix: Replace the SearchBar (114-129), chip SingleChildScrollView (131-141) and result Row (143-155) with a single MobileFilterBar (controller, searchHint, onSearchChanged, options as MobileFilterOption list, selected: filter, onSelected, resultLabel: '${visible.length} موظفًا', onClear to reset filter+search).

findings.summary: Search only fires on onSubmitted so typing does not filter until enter is pressed, and there is no 'clear filters' affordance, unlike MobileFilterBar which filters live and offers onClear.
findings.fix: Use onChanged (live filtering) and provide an onClear that resets both search and the 'all' filter — automatically handled by adopting MobileFilterBar.

findings.summary: _AttendanceBadge duplicates the pill visual formula (alpha .12 fill, radius 99, w900 text) already provided by the shared MobileStatusPill.
findings.fix: Map attendance statuses through MobileStatusPill (or extract a shared pill primitive) instead of a bespoke Container badge so pill styling stays centralized.

findings.summary: The error state is a plain icon plus raw '$error' text with no retry action, inconsistent with the branded error patterns and offering no recovery.
findings.fix: Add a button 'إعادة المحاولة' that calls ref.invalidate(mobileExecutivePeopleProvider(search)), and avoid rendering the raw exception string.

findings.summary: Header container hardcodes borderRadius 23 and padding 19, deviating from the design-system card radius 20 and standard even padding.
findings.fix: Use BorderRadius.circular(20) and EdgeInsets.all(16) to match the established card radius and spacing scale.

findings.summary: The search clear IconButton has no tooltip, unlike MobileFilterBar's clear button which sets tooltip 'مسح البحث'.
findings.fix: Add tooltip: 'مسح البحث' to the IconButton (or adopt MobileFilterBar which already includes it).

findings.summary: The error state uses a generic groups icon and no brand mark, missing the brand-consistent error header used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Add a BrandLogoMark above the icon/message in the error state to match the app's branded empty/error header pattern.
